LOGIN_HINT: Log in with a user of your CCU. This device stays logged in.
TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many failed attempts, please wait a minute
CCU_NOT_READY: The CCU is still starting, please try again in a moment
CONNECTION_LOST: No connection to the CCU, reconnecting …
NAME: Name
CONFIG_PENDING: Transfer pending: press a button on the device so it fetches the settings.
ELEVATE_HINT: To change settings, enter your password again (valid for 8 hours).
REMOVE_LINK_CONFIRM: Remove this link? The sender no longer controls the receiver.
PAIRING_HINT: Start pairing, then put the new device into pairing mode (see its manual).
WIRED_SEARCH_DONE: Search finished. Devices found are in the inbox.
DELETE_DEVICE_CONFIRM: Delete this device from the CCU? Its links and program references stop working.
DELETE_RESET: Reset the device to factory settings
DELETE_FORCE: Delete even if the device is not reachable
DUTY_CYCLE_HINT: Share of the allowed transmit time used in the last hour. At 100 % the CCU stops sending.
KEEP_SCREEN_ON_HINT: For a tablet on the wall; on this device only.
EFFECTS_HINT: Glow and animations on this device
CHANNELS_LOAD_FAILED: The devices could not be loaded
APP_UPDATE_AVAILABLE: A new version of the app is available.
SETUP_DEVICES_HINT: Paired devices, their channels and settings.
ROOMS_AND_TRADES_HINT: Rooms and trades group the devices on the dashboard.
DELETE_GROUP_CONFIRM: Delete “{name}”? The devices stay; they just no longer belong to it.
DELETE_SYSVAR_CONFIRM: Delete the system variable “{name}”? Programs using it stop working.
NO_SERVICE_MESSAGES: No notices. All devices are fine.
WEEK_PROFILE_HINT: In Auto mode the thermostat follows this schedule.
NO_WEEK_PROFILE: This device has no week schedule.
PROFILE_SAVE_HINT: Battery devices fetch the new schedule the next time they wake up.
INSTALL_FIRMWARE_CONFIRM: Install firmware {version} on the device now? The device can't be used for a few minutes during the update.
FIRMWARE_UP_TO_DATE: The firmware is up to date.
FIRMWARE_NEW_AVAILABLE: New firmware {version} available. The CCU transfers it to the device in the background.
FIRMWARE_DELIVERING: Firmware {version} is being transferred to the device. For battery devices this can take hours.
FIRMWARE_READY: Firmware {version} is on the device and ready to install.
FIRMWARE_NO_INFO: The CCU has no newer firmware for this device.
FIRMWARE_PENDING: The update to firmware {version} is waiting for the device. Bring it into radio range and press its button.
FIRMWARE_LIVE_AVAILABLE: Firmware {version} can be installed. The access point keeps working meanwhile.
FIRMWARE_BIDCOS_AVAILABLE: Firmware {version} is on the CCU. The update transfers and installs it in one go; wake battery devices with their button first.
FIRMWARE_UNSUPPORTED: The installed firmware does not support this update.
FIRMWARE_AUTOMATIC: The update is carried out automatically in the background.
FIRMWARE_DEVICE_UNREACHABLE: The device can't be reached. Bring it into radio range of the CCU, press its system button if needed and try again.
FIRMWARE_UPDATE_RUNNING: An update of this device is already running.
FIRMWARE_BIDCOS_RUNNING: The CCU transfers and installs the firmware. This takes a few minutes, please keep the device within radio range.
FIRMWARE_PRESS_SYSTEM_BUTTON: Please bring the device within radio range and press its operating key.
FIRMWARE_SMOKE_TEST: To make sure the smoke detector is working properly, please perform a self-test by pressing the operating key.
FIRMWARE_DUTY_CYCLE_HIGH: The duty cycle of the CCU is very high at the moment. A device update is not possible right now, please try again later.
DEVFW_INTRO: The app fetches new firmware for your devices straight from eQ-3 and stores it on the CCU. The CCU then transfers it to the devices.
DEVFW_NO_UPDATES: The newest firmware for all devices is on the CCU.
DEVFW_CHECK_FAILED: eQ-3 can't be reached. Check the CCU's internet connection.
DEVFW_DOWNLOADED: Firmware {version} for {type} is now on the CCU.
DEVFW_NO_FILES: There is no device firmware on the CCU.
DEVFW_UPLOAD_HINT: For CCUs without internet: upload a firmware file (.tgz) from eQ-3.
DEVFW_INVALID: The file is no valid device firmware.
DEVFW_NEEDS_NEWER_CCU: This firmware needs a newer CCU firmware.
BACKUP_HINT: Saves all devices, rooms, programs, system variables and passwords of the CCU to an .sbk file, like the WebUI's backup.
BACKUP_PASSWORD_HINT: The backup contains every password of the CCU. Please enter your password again.
BACKUP_PASSWORD_HINT_ADMIN: Password of the CCU user "Admin" (leave empty if the WebUI has none).
BACKUP_WAIT: The CCU packs all data. This can take a few minutes.
BACKUP_TIMEOUT: The CCU took too long. Please try again or create the backup in the WebUI.
PRESS_HINT: tap for short, hold for long
SMOKE_TEST_HINT: Sounds the siren · press and hold
WP_COMBINED_HINT: Combined from time of day and sun position (set in the WebUI). Choosing above replaces it.
WP_FULL: All switching times are in use.
SCHEDULE_HINT: runs in the device, even without the CCU
WP_SAVE_CONFIRM: Save the schedule of "{name}" in the device? Battery devices take it over on their next contact.
FAVORITES_HINT: Put together your own lists of devices, system variables and programs, such as "Evening" or "Vacation". They also apply in the CCU's web interface.
FAVORITE_EMPTY: This list is still empty. Use "Edit" to add devices, system variables and programs.
DELETE_FAVORITE_CONFIRM: The list is deleted; the devices, variables and programs in it stay.
LINK_NO_PROFILES: There are no profiles for this combination. The parameters are shown as the devices describe them.
PRG_KIND_OTHER: Set in the CCU's web interface (stays unchanged)
BREAK_ON_RESTART: Stop running delays of these actions first
DELETE_PROGRAM_CONFIRM: The program is deleted in the CCU.
PROGRAM_INVALID: Please enter a name. Names may not contain quotes, texts and scripts no ^.
PROGRAM_SAVE_CONFIRM: Save the program "{name}" in the CCU? It is activated if "Active" is set.
PROGRAM_HINT: As in the CCU's web interface: the conditions of a group apply together, groups are joined as set.
PRG_TM_ASTRO_HINT: The CCU calculates sunrise and sunset from its location (system settings).
LAYOUT_SAVED: Arrangement saved, applies on all devices
PUSH_HINT: On this device, also when the app is closed.
PUSH_INSECURE: Notifications need a secure connection: open the app via https://.
PUSH_UNSUPPORTED: This browser can't receive notifications. On an iPhone, add the app to the home screen.
PUSH_DENIED: Notifications are blocked in the browser.
SYS_LOCATE_FAILED: This device's location is not available
SYS_LOCATION_HINT: The CCU uses it to compute sunrise and sunset for programs with astro timing.
SYS_REBOOT_CONFIRM: The CCU saves its settings and restarts. For a few minutes it cannot be reached and switches nothing.
SYS_SHUTDOWN_CONFIRM: The CCU saves its settings and powers off. It only runs again after briefly disconnecting its power supply.
SYS_POWER_UNAVAILABLE: Restarting and shutting down only work when the add-on runs on the CCU itself.
USERS_PASSWORD_HINT: Allowed are letters without umlauts, digits and . = ! $ ( ) : ; # * - . Leave empty for no password.
USERS_SHOW_LOGIN: Show on the WebUI's login page
USERS_HINT: Administrators may set up everything, users operate and guests only look. Whoever gets a new password or other rights, or is deleted, is logged out on every device. Your own rights cannot be changed.
USERS_EXISTS: A user with this name already exists
USERS_FORBIDDEN_CHARS: Not allowed are < > ' " & $ [ ] \ ^ and curly braces
USERS_PASSWORD_CHARS: The password contains characters that are not allowed
USERS_DELETE_CONFIRM: {name} and their favorites will be deleted.
HIST_HINT: Changes of the logged channels and system variables, newest first. Which channels are logged is set by the option "logged" on the device page.
HIST_CLEAR_CONFIRM: All entries of the system protocol are deleted in the CCU.
SELF_UPDATE_CHECKSUM: The download was corrupted (checksum mismatch). Nothing was installed, please try again.
SELF_UPDATE_ALREADY_RUNNING: An update is being installed already.
ADDONS_HINT: To update an add-on, simply install its new version.
ADDONS_RESTART_SELF: This app restarts. The connection drops briefly and then comes back by itself.
ADDONS_UNINSTALL_CONFIRM: {name} is removed from the CCU. Its settings may be lost.
PW_HINT: Allowed are letters without umlauts, digits and . = ! $ ( ) : ; # * - . Other devices of this user are logged out.
VKEYS_HINT: The CCU's own keys: programs react to them like to a wall button. Press them short or long here.
VKEYS_SHOW_ALL: Show all {count} keys, also unnamed ones without a program
REPLACE_HINT: {name} ({type}) takes the place of an existing device of the same type, with its name, rooms, settings, direct links and programs.
REPLACE_NONE: There is no device this device can replace.
REPLACE_FAILED_LIST: The replaceable devices could not be queried.
REPLACE_WARNING: {old} then disappears from the CCU. Do not power the old device again, it would interfere with the new one.
COMTEST_HINT: The CCU asks the device to answer. Battery devices only answer when they wake up; briefly press a button on the device for that.
DEVHIST_NONE: No channel of this device is logged. The option “logged” is under names, rooms and functions.
DEVHIST_EMPTY: No entries in the system protocol yet.
DEVHIST_HINT: From the last {count} entries of the system protocol per channel.
FW_UPDATE_HINT: Download the file from the download page and install it with “Install firmware”.
LOG_HINT: As in the WebUI's central maintenance. Verbose levels fill the CCU's storage quickly – only turn them on for troubleshooting.
SCRIPT_HINT: The script really runs on the CCU and can change anything. Its syntax is checked first.
SYS_CLOCK_HINT: As the WebUI's time and position settings. With time servers the CCU sets its clock itself; by hand only without internet.
HG_HINT: The CCU's heating groups with their members. The group itself is a device of its own, operated and set up like any other. Creating, changing and deleting goes through the CCU's group administration, as in the WebUI.
RESTORE_HINT: A backup replaces every setting, device, program and password of the CCU. Afterwards the CCU restarts.
RESTORE_CONFIRM: The backup “{name}” is valid. Restore it now? All current settings are lost, the CCU restarts and is unreachable for a few minutes.
RESTORE_KEY: System security key of the backup
RESTORE_DONE: The backup is restored, the CCU restarts. This takes a few minutes; reload this page afterwards.
RESTORE_INVALID: The file is no system backup of the CCU.
RESTORE_WRONG_KEY: The security key fits neither the backup nor the CCU.
RESTORE_FIRMWARE_TOO_OLD: The backup is from a newer firmware. Update the CCU's firmware first.
CCUFW_DOWNLOAD_HINT: The CCU downloads OpenCCU {version} straight from GitHub. The server checks the SHA256 checksum, then you accept the licence and the CCU installs the update when it restarts. The download takes a few minutes, depending on the line.
CCUFW_NOT_STAGED: No checked update is ready any more (the CCU clears its temporary storage on restart). Please download or upload it again.
CCUFW_CHECKSUM: The downloaded file does not match its checksum and was discarded. Please try again.
CCUFW_DOWNLOAD_FAILED: The CCU could not download the firmware. Check the CCU's internet connection.
CCUFW_HINT: Upload a firmware file for the CCU (e.g. .zip or .tgz from the download page). The CCU checks it, then restarts and installs it.
CCUFW_PASSWORD: For security, please enter your password once more.
CCUFW_CONFIRM: “{name}” is a valid firmware. Best create a backup first. The CCU restarts to install it and is unreachable for a few minutes.
CCUFW_BACKUP_FIRST: Create and download a backup first
CCUFW_GITHUB_HINT: Or download the file yourself and upload it with “Install firmware”
CCUFW_DONE: The CCU restarts and installs the firmware. This takes a few minutes; reload this page afterwards.
CCUFW_INVALID: The file is no firmware for this CCU.
ADDON_INSTALL_HINT: Install or update an add-on (.tar.gz). It runs with full rights on the CCU – only use files from a trusted source.
ADDON_INSTALL_WAIT: Installing may take a few minutes.
ADDON_INSTALLED_REBOOT: The add-on is installed. The CCU restarts to finish; reload this page afterwards.
DIAG_DELETE_QUESTION: Do you really want to delete the diagram “{name}”? The recorded values are kept.
DIAG_NONE_ADMIN: Create a diagram: from then on the add-on records the chosen values.
DIAG_HINT: The add-on records every number or switch value used in a diagram, system variables too. Values per minute are kept for 60 days, per hour for good. No microSD card is needed. For logged channels a new diagram takes over the values from the system protocol.
DIAG_ZOOM_HINT: Drag in the diagram to zoom in
DIAG_NO_DATA: No values were recorded for this period.
DIAG_SEARCH: Search device, channel or system variable
DIAG_MAX_SERIES: At most {count} data sources per diagram
GEN_ENERGY_HINT: With these prices the diagrams show the costs of consumption. Calorific value and condition number are on the gas bill and turn m³ into kWh.
GEN_LED_HINT: For central units with an info LED (CCU3)
GEN_HIDE_STICKY_HINT: Acknowledges the messages of devices that were unreachable for a while automatically
GEN_BETA_HINT: Also offers test versions from eQ-3 when searching for device firmware
HG_DELETE_QUESTION: Do you really want to delete the heating group “{name}”? Its members can then be operated alone again.
HG_FORBID_HINT: The group's thermostats can then only be operated through the group
HG_CANDIDATES_FAILED: Suitable thermostats could not be loaded: {error}
HG_LEFTOVER: Already in another group: {names}. Remove them there first.
HG_PASSWORD_HINT: Changes through the CCU need a WebUI session once. It then lasts for further changes.
SEC_SSH_HINT: Log in as root over SSH, e.g. for maintenance and add-ons
SEC_AUTH_HINT: Programs like Home Assistant or ioBroker then need user name and password. The add-on runs on the CCU itself and is not affected.
SEC_HTTPS_HINT: Requests over http:// are answered encrypted over https://
SEC_RESTART_HINT: To apply this the CCU's web server restarts; the connection drops briefly.
SEC_SAVED_RESTART: Saved. The CCU's web server restarts.
SEC_KEY_HINT: The HomeMatic radio devices (BidCos) secure their communication with this key. The central unit passes a new key to all devices.
SEC_KEY_RULE: At least 5 characters: letters A–Z, digits and underscore
SEC_KEY_WARNING: Write the key down and keep it safe. Without it devices cannot be paired again after a reset of the central unit, and backups cannot be restored. It cannot be read out.
SEC_KEY_SAME: This already is the central unit's current key.
SEC_KEY_NOT_ALL: The current key has not reached all devices yet. Look at the service messages.
NET_GATEWAY_OUTSIDE: The gateway is not in the network of the IP address.
NET_MANUAL_WARNING: Careful: with a wrong address the central unit cannot be reached after the restart.
NET_RESTART_HINT: The central unit takes the new settings on its next start.
FW_POLICY_RESTRICTIVE_HINT: Only the web interface and the services and ports allowed below are reachable.
FW_POLICY_OPEN_HINT: All ports are open; the services below apply as set.
FW_XMLRPC_HINT: Allows direct access to paired Homematic devices
FW_REGA_HINT: Allows access to the logic layer of the Homematic central unit
FW_MEDIOLA_HINT: Allows access to the Mediola service
FW_ACCESS_HINT: Restricted: access only from the IP addresses below.
FW_IPS_HINT: Single addresses (192.168.0.1) or ranges (192.168.0.0/16), IPv4 and IPv6, separated by “;”.
LGW_HINT: RF LAN gateways, HM-CFG-LAN and the RS485 gateway for Homematic (BidCos). The central unit takes changes on its next start.
LGW_KEY_FORBIDDEN: Curly braces and the characters < > ' " & $ ? [ ] # \ are not allowed
LGW_SAVED_RESTART: Configuration saved. The changes take effect on the next start of the central unit.
LGW_ASSIGNMENT_HINT: Which radio module the central unit uses for a device. With roaming it picks the module itself.
LGW_REMOVE_QUESTION: Do you really want to remove the gateway “{name}”?
PAIR_LOCAL: Pair without internet access (with KEY and SGTIN)
PAIR_LOCAL_HINT: Only this device is paired, with the key from its label instead of the key server. Dashes may be entered.
PAIR_SERIAL_DONE: Device {serial} paired – it is in the inbox.
PAIR_KEY_TEXT: The device {serial} could not be paired. It probably uses a different system security key. Enter the device's key and try again.
PAIR_KEY_LABEL: System security key of the device
SETTINGS_NO_CHANGES: Change a setting to transfer it to the device.
SETTINGS_TRANSFERRED: The settings are stored in the device.
SETTINGS_HANDED_OVER: Saved. The central unit transfers the settings to the device.
SETTINGS_TRANSFER_HINT: The central unit transfers the settings to the device. Battery devices only fetch them when they wake up (e.g. after pressing a button on the device).
CERT_GENERATED: The central unit uses its automatically generated certificate.
CERT_HINT: You can upload your own certificate: a PEM file with the certificate and its private key. The web server of the central unit restarts afterwards.
CERT_DELETE_QUESTION: The own certificate is deleted; the central unit generates its own again when the web server restarts.
CERT_TOO_LARGE: The file is too large for a certificate.
CERT_INVALID: The file must contain a certificate and its private key (PEM).
CERT_UPLOADED: Certificate saved. The web server restarts.
CERT_DELETED: Certificate deleted. The web server restarts.
CERT_RESTART_HINT: After the upload the web server restarts; the WebUI is briefly unreachable.
SEC_TIMEOUT_HINT: After this time without use a session of the old WebUI ends. Raise it if you get the message “session expired”. The central unit takes the value on its next start.
SEC_TIMEOUT_RANGE: Please choose a time between 180 and 600 seconds.
SEC_TIMEOUT_SAVED: Saved. The central unit takes the value on its next start.
RESET_HINT: Resets the central unit to its delivery state. It has to be set up again afterwards.
RESET_WARNING: The central unit is reset to factory settings and restarts. This deletes:
RESET_WARNING_DEVICES: all paired devices, rooms, functions, programs, system variables and settings
RESET_WARNING_ADDON: all add-on software – this add-on too; afterwards only the WebUI of the central unit is left
RESET_WARNING_BACKUP: Create a backup first if you want to keep any of it.
RESET_STARTED: The central unit is being reset to factory settings and restarts. This add-on is removed; log in to the WebUI of the central unit afterwards.
SEC_LEVEL_HIGH_HINT: Only the web interface is reachable; programming interfaces and Mediola are blocked, authentication is on.
SEC_LEVEL_MEDIUM_HINT: Interfaces, add-ons and Mediola only from the allowed networks; authentication is on.
SEC_LEVEL_LOW_HINT: All ports open, XML-RPC and Mediola for everyone, no authentication. Only if you protect the central unit yourself.
SEC_LEVEL_HINT: A level sets the firewall and authentication together. Later changes to the firewall make it “custom”.
SEC_LEVEL_SAVED: Security level set. The web server restarts.
DISPLAY_HINT: Up to 15 characters per line, depending on their width. A space clears a line.
SYS_SAFE_MODE_CONFIRM: The central unit starts once in safe mode: installed add-ons are not started, this one neither. The old WebUI stays reachable; a normal restart ends the mode. Changed settings are saved before.
SYS_SAFE_MODE_STARTING: The central unit starts in safe mode. This add-on is not reachable until the next normal restart.
SYS_REGA_HINT: Which version of the logic layer (ReGaHss) the CCU uses. Switch to compatibility mode if older scripts cause trouble.
SYS_REGA_RESTART: The CCU has to restart for the new logic layer version to take effect.
SEC_SNMP_HINT: After activation, the SNMP service is active. Only SNMPv3 with SHA and AES is supported.
SEC_SNMP_RULES: User name of letters, digits, . _ -; password at least 8 characters, without quotes and backslash.
LANGUAGE_HINT_USER: Applies to your CCU user on every device and in the old WebUI; Automatic follows the browser.
LANGUAGE_HINT_DEVICE: Applies to this device; Automatic follows the browser.
HELP_CCU_LICENSES: Licence information of the CCU software
HELP_COPYRIGHT: The CCU software is based on the OCCU SDK by eQ-3 AG, Leer; OpenCCU is licensed under Apache 2.0.
HEALTH_FAILED: The device values could not be loaded.
HEALTH_HINT: Values from each device's maintenance channel. "Low soon" means at most 10 % above the voltage at which the device reports "battery empty". Signal is the weaker value of both directions (RSSI). Devices that only send on changes may have reported a while ago.
RULE_DELETE_CONFIRM: The rule is deleted. Notifications it already sent stay on the devices.
RULE_NONE: No rules yet. A rule sends a push notification once devices are in a certain state, e.g. a window is open for more than 15 minutes.
RULE_HINT: The add-on checks rules itself, without a program in the CCU. Each device chooses in the menu under Notifications → Rules whether it receives them. A rule notifies once, and again only after its conditions stopped holding in between.
RULE_CONDITIONS_HINT: All conditions must hold at the same time, e.g. window open and outside temperature below 10 °C.
RULE_DURATION: Holding for at least (0 = at once)
RULE_MESSAGE_HINT: Without an own text the notification shows the conditions, as suggested in the field.
PICKER_SEARCH: Search: name, device, type, room, address
DEVICE_SAVE_HINT: Name, rooms, trades and options are saved right away. Settings are collected below and only take effect after “Save and transfer”.
USERS_AUTO_LOGIN_HINT: Whoever opens the app is logged in as this user without a password. Only one user can be; after logging out, the login appears.
ONLY_ON_CCU: Only available when the add-on runs on the CCU itself (the setting is in files of the CCU). Until then in the old WebUI:
UPDATE_CONFIRM: The new version is downloaded from GitHub, checked and installed. The CCU does not restart, only this app is unreachable for a few seconds and then reloads by itself.
UPDATE_RUNNING_HINT: Please keep this window open, it usually takes less than a minute.
UPDATE_NOT_BACK: The server did not come back after the update. Please check the CCU and reload the app afterwards.
UPDATE_WRONG_VERSION: {version} was installed, but the server reports {running}. Please check the add-on in the WebUI.
UPDATE_OTHER_TABS: The update is installed. The app is still open in another tab of this browser, which reloads too when the new version is taken over. Save everything there first, then "Reload now" here.
UPDATE_APP_FAILED: The update is installed, but the new app could not be loaded yet. Once "Reload" appears at the bottom, take over the new version with it.
UPDATE_OLD_APP: {version} is installed on the CCU, but {running} is still running here. "Reload now" takes over the new version.
